author: Bahnfrend
attribution: Photo: Bahnfrend, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tom_Mboya_Street,_2025_(15).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Raised black serif letters fixed to a rusticated stone course on the corner of the National Archives building, Nairobi; seen slightly from the left with peeling paint. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Bahnfrend
attribution: Photo: Bahnfrend, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Name_sign,_Uhuru_Park,_2025_(01).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Black 3D letters on a grey gateway wall with red/green/black/white flag stripes, Nairobi; shot upward at an angle. 'Karibu' (Swahili 'welcome') is in widely spaced lowercase between two bars. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Masssly
attribution: Photo: Masssly, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shop_signage_in_Tamil_language,_Nairobi_-_Kenya.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow Latin letters on a black box sign over a closed shutter in a mall (Village Market area, Nairobi), in a decorative Devanagari-style font with a head bar and a chandrabindu-like flourish over the second 'a'. The file title says Tamil, but the text is Latin. A partial tagline to the right ('...ndian CURRIES &') is cut off and left out; bright ceiling light glare above. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Shop signage in Tamil language, Nairobi - Kenya.jpg
source_categories: Masssly uploads from Wikimania 2025, Nairobi, Kenya

author: KamauxKamau
attribution: Photo: KamauxKamau, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sunrise_at_an_airport.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hanging blue terminal sign with gold letters and an arrival-plane pictogram at JKIA, Nairobi. Sun glare washes out the end of the second line: only 'INT'L ARRI' is legible (the rest, presumably 'VALS', is not transcribed). Barclays/ATM and 'INFO' boards are distractors; travellers are incidental.

author: shankar s. from Dubai, united arab emirates
attribution: Photo: shankar s. from Dubai, united arab emirates, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Signage_in_Lake_Nakuru_National_Park_(7513072724).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Stone junction marker no. 8 in Lake Nakuru National Park with orange painted boards. The right-hand board has 'KM' with no distance numbers (blank). The angled lower board is small; dot leaders are approximate. The top 'OBEY PARK REGULATIONS' board is rules text and left out.
source_title: File:Signage in Lake Nakuru National Park (7513072724).jpg

author: Alexandra Cadet
attribution: Photo: Alexandra Cadet, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Auto_and_repairs_shop.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted red-on-white board over a green wooden kiosk. 'J·N' uses a middle dot; 'EXPART' is the sign's own misspelling of 'expert'. The phone number after 'CALL:' is blurred out in the source image.

author: CaptChandra
attribution: Photo: CaptChandra, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kenyan_Barber_Shop_sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted barbershop front in Turkana with rasta-gradient capitals and two painted haircut portraits (artwork, not real faces). 'Kinyozi' is Swahili for barber. The tiny painter credit ('Drawn By: ... ARTS CENTRE' and a phone number) between the words is left out.

author: Queen Asali
attribution: Photo: Queen Asali, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bishop_Gatimu_Girls_-_signage.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

expect.query: Bishop Gatimu Ngandu Girls High School

notes: Green raised letters on the white panel atop the school gate arch, Nyeri County. The 'TAKE A GIRL MAKE A LEADER' motto board and a partly hidden repeat of the name on the right wall are distractors; a motorcyclist at the far left is incidental.

author: Queen Asali
attribution: Photo: Queen Asali, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pwani_University_-_Kilifi_County.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue raised capitals on the white gate arch at Kilifi, between two blue dots, with a palm-tree logo globe on top. Small 'PEPSI THIRSTY' and 'PWANI SHO...' signs at the bottom are distractors.
source_categories: Schools in Kenya by educational level

author: Creeddd
attribution: Photo: Creeddd, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_outside_Karen_Blixen_museum.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hanging white-and-orange museum sign on chains over the roadside in Karen, Nairobi, with the NMK logo and a line drawing of the house; slightly bowed shape.

author: Renvoy
attribution: Photo: Renvoy, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Maasai_Mara_University_sign_in_Narok,_Kenya.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Cream direction board in a red frame with the university crest between two arrows, at a busy junction in Narok; tiny 'ISO 9001:2015 certified' under the name is left out. Many distractors: 'Welcome to IMANI ORPHAN CARE FOUNDATION', 'WORLDWIDE GOSPEL CHURCH OF KENYA', 'BILAL SCHOOLS NAROK', 'CAUTION WORK IN PROGRESS', '(SI)GN WRITING DONE HERE', a 'NYAMA CHOMA' board, and motorbike riders and plates (incidental).
source_title: File:Maasai Mara University sign in Narok, Kenya.jpg

author: Robot8A
attribution: Photo: Robot8A, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Panoramax. Source: https://panoramax.openstreetmap.fr/#focus=pic&pic=9b3b1821-62da-4b9b-a8c2-9c536e27034c. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. crop 75,0,3405,2160 of the 3840x2160 HD picture.
notes: Green fascia over a two-storey commercial building at dusk, Nairobi. Distractors: the HMD billboard, the 'Farmers World Limited' signs, the taps clock pillar, 'JESUS CHRIST IS THE LORD / UNIVERSAL' and 'YOGI...' at right, and matatus in the foreground. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
